name: @funcd-dev/example-egress-probe
description: A funcd egress-enforcement example (ADR-0117, F81): a probe function that tries to open an outbound connection to a given URL and reports whether the in-binary egress gateway ALLOWED or REFUSED it — proving default-deny, allow-list permits, and the sni-spoof/forwarder-attestation invariant on real containerd. Authored in TypeScript against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles it to a self-contained probe.mjs; the I/O contract lives in funcdctl.yaml.
